provenance.label: Hyperliquid mainnet perpetual 5m candles from the public info API (candleSnapshot, closed bars only); executed-trade aggregates from a forward recording of the public trades WebSocket stream (venue block time, receipt cutoff)

train.role: selection: the parameter grid and the frozen selection rule read only this window (two 4h sessions)

test.role: held-out: scored once with the frozen selection (one 4h session)

acquisition.source: POST https://api.hyperliquid.xyz/info candleSnapshot + fundingHistory (shared_tools/funding_fetcher.py); trade flow is not acquirable here and comes only from run_study.py prepare
